Lifted
sources.content:
{{Infobox | Box title = Lifted | image = HeavySlamAttackLifted.gif }} '''{{D|Lifted}}''' is a [[Status Effect]] caused by certain [[melee]] attacks that knocks enemies airborne and briefly suspends them in mid-air in a ragdolled state. Lifted enemies can be "juggled" with repeated procs, and certain equipment and abilities provide bonuses to Lifted enemies. Lifted procs last 1 second at base, increasing by 1 second for every [[Melee Combo]] tier, up to 12 seconds at 12x combo. ==Mechanics== {{UpdateMe}} *Any attack that procs Lifted while an enemy is in a Lifted state will prematurely end the state and [[ragdoll]]s the enemy. **Any non-melee attack on an enemy in a Lifted state will also prematurely end it. ==Sources of Lifted== *Some Melee [[Heavy Attack]]s. *All Heavy [[Slam Attack]]s. *Naramon's {{Focus|Void Levitation}}. ===Abilities=== {{#tag:tabber| Bonewidow = {{:Shield Maiden}} {{:Firing Line}} {{!}}-{{!}} Sevagoth = {{:Embrace}} {{!}}-{{!}} }} ===Miscellaneous=== File:Mausolon.png|link=Mausolon|alt=MausolonAlt-Fire|{{Weapon|Mausolon}}
Alt-Fire File:TelosBoltace.png|link=Telos_Boltace|alt=Telos BoltaceSecond hit of Stormpath|{{Weapon|Telos Boltace}}
Second hit of Stormpath File:CrescentChargeMod.png|link=Crescent_Charge|alt=Crescent Charge|{{M|Crescent Charge}} ==Effects That Benefit From Lifted Procs== SaxumCarapaceMod.png|link=Saxum Carapace|{{M|Saxum Carapace}}|alt=Saxum Carapace SaxumSpittleMod.png|link=Saxum Spittle|{{M|Saxum Spittle}}|alt=Saxum Spittle SaxumThoraxMod.png|link=Saxum Thorax|{{M|Saxum Thorax}}|alt=Saxum Thorax EnduringAfflictionMod.png|link=Enduring Affliction|{{M|Enduring Affliction}}|alt=Enduring Affliction EnduringStrikeMod.png|link=Enduring Strike|{{M|Enduring Strike}}|alt=Enduring Strike Cedo.png|link=Cedo|{{Weapon|Cedo}} (counts towards Primary Fire's damage bonus)|alt=Cedo (counts towards Primary Fire's damage bonus) ExodiaValor.png|link=Exodia Valor|{{Arcane|Exodia Valor}}|alt=Exodia Valor ConditionOverloadMod.png|link=Condition Overload|{{M|Condition Overload}} (counts towards damage bonus)|alt=Condition Overload (counts towards damage bonus) GalvanizedAptitudeMod.png|link=Galvanized Aptitude|{{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} (counts towards damage bonus)|alt=Galvanized Aptitude (counts towards damage bonus) GalvanizedSavvyMod.png|link=Galvanized Savvy|{{M|Galvanized Savvy}} (counts towards damage bonus)|alt=Galvanized Savvy (counts towards damage bonus) GalvanizedShotMod.png|link=Galvanized Shot|{{M|Galvanized Shot}} (counts towards damage bonus)|alt=Galvanized Shot (counts towards damage bonus) ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|37}} *Fixed a bug where the Melee Lifted Status Effect could fling enemies unintentionally. {{ver|26.0.7}} *Fixed Exodia Valor considering every target to be Lifted whether they actually are or not. {{ver|26}} *Introduced.}} {{DamageNav}} [[Category:Update 26]] [[Category:Status]] [[Category:Melee 2.0]]
